blocks.content: 6.1 Space and Defence Research in Tamil Nadu

items: ISRO: Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SDSC) SHAR is in Sriharikota, Andhra Pradesh – but close to Tamil Nadu border; many ISRO scientists are from Tamil Nadu
DRDO: Combat Vehicles Research and Development Establishment (CVRDE), Chennai – Arjun MBT developed here
Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre (VSSC): Kerala, but connected to Tamil Nadu research ecosystem
APJ Abdul Kalam: Former President of India; born in Rameswaram, Tamil Nadu; known as 'Missile Man of India'
IGCAR (Indira Gandhi Centre for Atomic Research): Kalpakkam, near Chennai – Fast Breeder Reactor research
Madras Atomic Power Station: Kalpakkam – two BWRs; first indigenously built nuclear power plant

cells: Premier engineering institute; oldest IIT in South India
National Institute of Technology; top NIT in India

items: Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve: First biosphere reserve in India (1986); covers TN, Kerala, Karnataka; Mudumalai, Bandipur, Nagarhole, Mukurthi, Silent Valley
Gulf of Mannar Biosphere Reserve: Marine biosphere; 21 islands; coral reefs, seagrasses, dugongs; first marine biosphere reserve in South and Southeast Asia

blocks.content: Tamil Nadu faces several environmental challenges including water scarcity, deforestation in the Nilgiris, coastal erosion, and pollution from industrial zones like Ambattur and SIPCOT areas.

items: Cauvery Water Dispute: Ongoing dispute between Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Kerala, and Puducherry
Mullaiperiyar Dam Dispute: Tamil Nadu and Kerala; dam safety and water sharing
Marina Beach: Second longest urban beach in the world (after Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh); 13 km long
Mangroves: Pichavaram mangrove forest (Cuddalore) is one of the world's largest mangrove forests
